records.kind: public accounts committee directs state audit of the central bank
records.summary: Pakistan's National Assembly Public Accounts Committee, chaired by MNA Noor Alam Khan, directed the Auditor General to conduct an audit of the State Bank of Pakistan over the disbursement of about Rs1,145 billion in TERF concessional loans, after a preliminary report from NAB and the Auditor General, and directed an inquiry into whether the loans were disbursed on merit.
records.source_title: PAC Directs Auditor General to Conduct Audit of State Bank Over TERF Loans

records.kind: parliamentary standing committee review of the central bank, reported to Parliament
records.summary: Fiji's Parliamentary Standing Committee on Economic Affairs reviewed the Reserve Bank of Fiji's 2018/19, 2019/20 and 2020/21 annual reports, took a written submission from the Bank dated 19 January 2022 and questioned the Governor and his team, then tabled a consolidated review report (Parliamentary Paper No. 17 of 2022) directing the Bank to fully utilise the housing facility allocation and to strengthen cybersecurity with the Fiji Financial Intelligence Unit.
records.source_title: Consolidated Review Report of the Reserve Bank of Fiji 2018/19, 2019/20, 2020/2021 Annual Reports, Parliamentary Paper No. 17 of 2022

records.people: Bo Bo Nge (deputy governor of the Central Bank of Myanmar)
records.summary: Bo Bo Nge, deputy governor of the Central Bank of Myanmar appointed in 2017, was convicted of graft, officially of mismanagement of banks trading foreign currency, and sentenced by a junta court to 20 years in prison after a months-long secret trial, as reported on 16 December 2022.
records.source_title: Myanmar junta sentences former Central Bank official to 20 years in prison
